name: kiln
description: The Kiln build run. Ships the build skill (one run per ticket: it fills the ticket's brief, builds its tasks one change at a time, has a judge rule on the whole, and opens the pull request on the person's yes), the shape skill (a three-lens design dialogue that ends at a written decision), and the Classes the run dispatches: the Crafter, the Designer, the Planner, the Inspector, and the Prospector. Carries the runtime bundle, the roster policy, the rations, the host bindings, the price table, and the borrowed-review pins.
